general.name: Docker Images monitor [Lin]
general.description: Alerts when a container on a moving tag is behind its registry tag by over N days; containers on pinned tags are reported, never alerted.

variables.name: usrMinAgeDays
variables.description: An update does not count until the new image is this many days old. 0-365; 0 disables.

variables.name: usrExcludePattern
variables.description: ERE matched against container names; matches are skipped. e.g. ^(postgres|mysql)

variables.name: usrCacheHours
variables.description: Reuse a previous registry lookup for this long. 0-720; 168 = weekly.

variables.name: usrStaleAfterDays
variables.description: Alert on an image reference with no successful registry answer for this many days, naming the last error. 0-365; 0 turns it off.
